answer: Proof of Personhood via biometrics acts as a robust inlet for identity verification, preventing an attacker from spawning an ivory tower of automated sockpuppets. By requiring a unique physical signature, the cost of an attack shifts from negligible computation to the massive logistical expense of acquiring synthetic biological artifacts. Much like the distinct trajectory of a comet, each verified entity leaves an immutable trace, forcing adversaries to burn significant real-world resources to manipulate the consensus.
